answers.core: This is too interconnected with the core UI system to be done through an add-on.
answers.workaround: Not really. I previously put together a hack using Area2D nodes inside my UI and setting the control nodes' mouse filter to ignore, but found myself reimplementing the GUI input system from scratch.

title: Add `Control::MOUSE_FILTER_TRAVERSE` to allow control nodes to receive input while still letting it through
